Strange sightings, unexplained encounters and evidence that challenges everything we think we know. In Expedition X, the team investigates reports of paranormal activity, searching for answers in places where the unexplained refuses to stay hidden. But when the evidence starts adding up, can every mystery be explained?
Watch Expedition X, S4, Episodes 14, 10, 9, 2, 11, 7, 16, 8, 1 & 15 on Discovery Channel India.
